name: Antlia
introduction: is the Air Pump, introduced by Nicolas-Louis de Lacaille in the 1750s to honor the pump invented by Denis Papin. It is a faint constellation in the southern sky.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: The ultracool dwarf [DENIS J1048−3956](id:10pc-0065), about 13 light-years away, lies in Antlia. Antlia 2, a huge but extremely faint satellite galaxy of the Milky Way, was discovered in 2018.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Alpha Antliae](hip:51172) is an orange giant about 365 light-years away and the brightest star.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: The Antlia Cluster of galaxies lies about 130 million light-years away.
